summary.text: Stacie McGinn is the Republican candidate for the North Carolina State Senate, District 42, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Woodson Bradley (D).
McGinn is an attorney and former Bank of America executive who ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Stacie McGinn earned a high school diploma from Mayfield High School, a bachelor's degree from Baylor University and a law degree from the Georgetown University Law Center, according to Ballotpedia.

In a Ballotpedia survey, McGinn described herself as a lawyer and former top executive with Bank of America who has spent more than 35 years working on public policy matters, beginning in the Reagan Administration.
McGinn won the March 5, 2024 Republican primary for District 42 with 51.7% of the vote over Jaime Daniell.
Woodson Bradley defeated her in the November 5, 2024 general election, 62,260 votes to 62,051.
In the 2026 survey, McGinn named public safety, K-12 reading and math proficiency, and a business-friendly environment with low taxes among her key messages.
